links.title: Township of Edison Document Center - Official Forms & Applications Repository
links.summary: Centralized municipal repository for Edison Township permits, engineering zoning applications, road opening permits, and land use documents.
links.content:
TOWNSHIP OF EDISON - OFFICIAL DOCUMENT CENTER & REPOSITORY (edisonnj.org/document_center/index.php)
1. JURISDICTION & DEPARTMENTS: Houses official municipal applications and permits across Engineering, Zoning Board, Public Works, Health Department, Code Enforcement, and Township Clerk.
2. SUBMISSION CHANNELS: Documents can be submitted in-person at the Municipal Complex (100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817) or via designated departmental email dispatch (e.g. clerk@edisonnj.gov, opra@edisonnj.gov).
3. STANDARDIZED PDF INTAKE: All applicants must utilize official, un-altered municipal PDF forms. Photocopies and digital submissions must contain original inked or verified digital signatures.

links.title: Edison Township Zoning Permit Requirements & Submission Protocol
links.summary: Mandatory survey, plot plan, and setback submission requirements for all residential and commercial zoning permits.
links.content:
EDISON TOWNSHIP ZONING PERMIT REQUIREMENT SHEET (CHAPTER 39)
1. SURVEY REQUIREMENT: A current signed and sealed property survey (scale: 1 inch = 20 feet or 1 inch = 30 feet) prepared by a NJ licensed land surveyor must accompany all applications.
2. PROPOSED IMPROVEMENTS: The exact location, proposed dimensions, height, and setback distances (front, rear, side) of proposed construction must be clearly delineated on two (2) copies of the survey.
3. PERMIT TYPES: Required for additions, new dwellings, detached garages, sheds over 100 sq.ft., swimming pools (in-ground and above-ground), driveways, patios, and decks.
4. DECK & PATIO SETBACKS: Unenclosed open decks must observe a minimum 15-foot rear yard setback in residential R-A, R-B, and R-C zones, and must not exceed maximum impervious lot coverage limits.
5. INTAKE ROUTING: Submit completed Zoning Application along with survey to Division of Zoning, Municipal Complex, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817.

links.title: Edison Township Official Zoning Permit Application Form
links.summary: Official standardized application for residential building additions, pools, decks, fences, accessory structures, and commercial site changes.
links.content:
EDISON TOWNSHIP ZONING APPLICATION (CODE 39-B)
1. APPLICANT DATA: Requires Block, Lot, Work Site Address, Property Owner Name, and Licensed Contractor Registration Number.
2. STRUCTURE DESCRIPTION: Applicant must indicate proposed work: Single-Family Dwelling, Addition, Shed, Fence (> 6ft), Inground Pool, Above-ground Pool, Deck, Retaining Wall, or Commercial Use Change.
3. DIMENSIONS & COVERAGE: Must declare existing ground building footprint, proposed addition footprint, accessory structure square footage, and total lot impervious coverage percentage.

links.title: Edison Township Zoning Permit Fee Schedule (Ordinance O.2158)
links.summary: Official schedule of zoning review fees for residential additions, accessory structures, fences, and commercial developments.
links.content:
EDISON TOWNSHIP ZONING PERMIT FEE SCHEDULE (ORDINANCE O.2158)
1. RESIDENTIAL FEES: Residential Fence: $50.00. Shed (under 200 sq.ft.): $50.00; Shed (> 200 sq.ft.): $100.00. Swimming Pool (Above-Ground): $75.00; In-Ground Pool: $150.00. Residential Addition / Alteration: $100.00. New Single-Family Dwelling: $200.00. Deck Construction: $75.00.
2. COMMERCIAL FEES: Change of Tenancy / Commercial Use: $250.00. Commercial Site Plan Zoning Review: $500.00 base.
3. PAYMENT PROTOCOL: Check payable to 'Township of Edison' or credit card at Engineering Intake Counter.

links.title: Township of Edison Street Opening Application
links.summary: Official Township of Edison Street Opening Application from the Department of Public Works for pavement cutting, utility trenching, and right-of-way excavation.
links.content:
EDISON TOWNSHIP STREET OPENING APPLICATION (DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS)
1. JURISDICTION: Listed under Public Works in the Edison Township Document Center.
2. UTILITY CLEARANCE: Mandatory 811 Call Before You Dig locate ticket number must be obtained prior to excavation.
3. PAVEMENT RESTORATION BOND: A refundable restoration guarantee deposit of $5,000.00 and $150 filing fee are required.
4. SUBMISSION INTAKE: Submit directly to Department of Public Works, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ.

links.title: Township of Edison Official Municipal Zoning District Map
links.summary: Official cartographic boundary delineations of R-A, R-B, R-C, Commercial C-1/C-2, and Light Industrial M-1 zones across Edison Township.
links.content:
EDISON TOWNSHIP ZONING DISTRICT DELINEATIONS
1. RESIDENTIAL CLASSIFICATIONS: R-A (Single-Family Estate), R-B (Single-Family Medium Density), R-C (Single-Family High Density), R-D (Multi-Family Attached).
2. SETBACK REQUIREMENTS: R-A: Front 35ft, Rear 25ft, Side 10ft. R-B: Front 25ft, Rear 20ft, Side 8ft. R-C: Front 20ft, Rear 15ft, Side 6ft.

links.title: Township of Edison Official Tree Permit (Removal/Replacement/Conservation) Application
links.summary: Official municipal permit application for tree removal, replacement, and conservation in Edison Township under Chapter 25 of the municipal code.
links.content:
EDISON TOWNSHIP TREE REMOVAL PERMIT APPLICATION
1. APPLICANT & PROPERTY DATA: Applicant details, Block, Lot, property address, and property owner consent.
2. REMOVAL JUSTIFICATION & DETAILS: Number of trees, species, diameter, and reason for removal.
3. EMERGENCY REMOVAL: Allowed immediately for dead, dying, or imminent hazards with photo proof or certified arborist letter, with concurrent permit filing.
4. FEES: Standard $25 review fee ($200 with board approval; fee waived for senior citizens aged 62+).

links.title: Township of Edison Soil Importation Permit Application
links.summary: Official municipal permit application for importing soil or clean fill onto properties in Edison Township.
links.content:
EDISON TOWNSHIP SOIL IMPORTATION PERMIT
1. CLEAN FILL CERTIFICATION: Requires certified laboratory clean fill chemical analysis.
2. SITE SURVEY: Topographical property survey showing proposed grading contours and placement.
3. TRUCK HAUL ROUTE: Approved truck haul route through Edison Township.
4. FEES & ESCROW: Soil importation review fee and engineering escrow deposit.

links.title: Township of Edison Soil Exportation Permit Application
links.summary: Official municipal permit application for exporting or moving soil off properties in Edison Township.
links.content:
EDISON TOWNSHIP SOIL EXPORTATION PERMIT
1. CUT/FILL CALCULATION: Topographical survey with cut/fill calculations by NJ licensed surveyor or engineer.
2. SOIL EROSION CERTIFICATION: Soil erosion and sediment control certification.
3. TRUCK HAUL ROUTE: Designated haul routes within Edison Township.
4. RESTORATION BOND: Municipal performance guarantee and restoration bond.

links.title: Township of Edison Site Improvement Permit Application with Checklist
links.summary: Official application and 25-point engineering checklist for site improvements, grading, disturbance, and impervious coverage.
links.content:
EDISON TOWNSHIP SITE IMPROVEMENT PERMIT (SIP)
1. SITE PLAN REQUIREMENT: Two (2) signed and sealed copies of engineering site improvement plan.
2. CHECKLIST: Complete 25-item municipal engineering checklist.
3. STORMWATER MANAGEMENT: Runoff calculations and drainage plan.
4. FEES: Standard engineering review and inspection escrow deposit.

links.title: Township of Edison Flood Zone Determination Letter Request
links.summary: Official request form to obtain written determination from the Division of Engineering regarding FEMA flood zone status.
links.content:
EDISON TOWNSHIP FLOOD ZONE DETERMINATION LETTER REQUEST
1. PROPERTY DATA: Requires Block, Lot, property address, and applicant contact details.
2. FEE: $25.00 Flood Letter Fee.
3. SUBMISSION: Division of Engineering, Municipal Complex, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817.

links.title: Township of Edison Requirements for Plot Grading Plans – Minor Development
links.summary: Mandatory engineering requirements for plot grading plans on minor developments.
links.content:
EDISON TOWNSHIP REQUIREMENTS FOR PLOT GRADING PLANS
1. SEAL REQUIREMENT: Must be prepared, signed, and sealed by a NJ licensed Professional Engineer or Land Surveyor.
2. BOUNDARY SURVEY OVERLAY: Must be overlaid on certified boundary survey with existing and proposed contours.
3. STORMWATER MANAGEMENT: On-site seepage pit infiltration per Title 34 and soil erosion sediment control measures.
4. SUBMISSION: Three (3) copies submitted with Site Improvement Permit (SIP) application to Division of Engineering.
